description: This Java source file contains an abstract base class for unit testing implementations of the AbstractCommandStrategy in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.things.persistence.actors.strategies.commands package. It includes import statements, static utility methods for testing command strategies with Thing objects, and mock setups for verifying behavior of command strategy implementations.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategyTest
classes.description: An abstract base class providing utility methods and setup for unit testing command strategy implementations related to Thing objects within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants, particularly mocking the logger used in tests.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates and returns a default command strategy context using a predefined ThingId and a mocked logger.

methods.name: assertModificationResult
methods.description: Asserts that applying a command strategy results in a modification event matching expected class and response, optionally confirming if deleted.

methods.name: assertErrorResult
methods.description: Verifies that applying the command strategy results in the expected error (exception).

methods.name: assertQueryResult
methods.description: Asserts that a query result matches the expected command response.

methods.name: assertUnhandledResult
methods.description: Verifies that an unhandled command produces the expected runtime exception as error response.
